name: Vmoto Limited
summary: Vmoto Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, manufacture, marketing, and distribution of electric two-wheel vehicle worldwide. Its electric two-wheel vehicle includes electric mopeds and motorcycles. The company offers its products primarily under the Vmoto, Super Soco, and E-Max brand names. Vmoto Limited was incorporated in 2001 and is based in West Perth, Australia.
